"''Just the good ones.|Wullf Yularen and Aayla Secura|}} The '''Sky Battle of Quell''' took place in the [[22 BBY/Legends|first year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in the skies over the contested [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Quell/Legends|Quell]] when [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and her [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] were ambushed by a [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]]. Meeting in Quell's upper [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], each faction launched [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] that engaged their enemies in [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]]. Although both sides took losses, it was Secura's forces from the [[327th Star Corps/Legends|327th Star Corps]] that suffered greater casualties when two of their three [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] fell to the [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|Confederate frigates']] heavy [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] [[Laser/Legends|fire]]. As the Separatist [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|tactical droid]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]], [[TF-1726/Legends|TF-1726]], dispatched [[B2-RP battle droid/Legends|B2-RP battle droids]] to board Secura's crippled [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]], the [[Liberty (Venator-class)/Legends|''Liberty'']], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] arrived with reinforcements aboard his own [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']]. Launching in [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]], Skywalker boarded the ''Liberty'' with his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and [[Troop/Legends|troops]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] led by [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]] to evacuate the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] before it could be destroyed. Skywalker, Tano, and CT-7567 were able to catch up with Secura and her [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|clone commander]], [[Bly/Legends|CC-5052]], during the fight to repel the Confederate [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] invaders from the ''Liberty''. Although Skywalker was seriously wounded while attempting to help his comrades evacuate the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], he, Secura, Tano, and several [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] successfully escaped from the ''Liberty'' aboard a [[Unidentified Consular-class cruiser (Quell)/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]]. Yet, when the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] attempted to dock to the ''Resolute'' so that Skywalker could receive proper medical attention, the small [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|vessel's]] [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] was inadvertently activated from an attack by a [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|vulture droid starfighter]] squadron. The three Jedi and the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] were unable to prevent their [[Starship/Legends|ship]] from jumping to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], leaving [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] and the ''Resolute'' to continue the battle against the Separatist armada with the remaining Republic forces, which were eventually defeated. ==Prelude== By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Quell/Legends|Quell]]—the principal planet of the [[Quell system/Legends|Quell system]]—had become a contested site between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the opposing [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. However, Quell's state of contention soon escalated when [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] forces from both sides of the ongoing war met in the highest levels of the planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] to engage in battle.{{DB|location|quell|Quell}} ==The battle== {{Quote|Nice entrance, Skywalker. How do you plan to get us out of this mess?''"
"''Well, I have a ship docking in the lower hangar as we speak.|Aayla Secura confers with Anakin Skywalker while rushing the Separatist battle droids|}} While on a mission to Quell,{{FactFile2014|36|BLY 1-4|Bly}} [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and her [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]] of three [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] were ambushed in the planet's upper atmosphere by a [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of seven [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]]. Both sides launched [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|units]] in opposition to the other, with Secura deploying groups of [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]] and the Confederates—led by the [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] [[TF-1726/Legends|TF-1726]] from his [[TF-1726's Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|command ship]]—sending out [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|vulture droid fighters]] in retaliation. While the Separatists lost only one ''Munificent''-class [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]], those remaining concentrated intense [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] [[Laser/Legends|fire]] on the trio of Republic [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]. Heavily outnumbered, Secura's [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] began to take heavy losses. Eventually, only Secura's own [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]], the [[Liberty (Venator-class)/Legends|''Liberty'']], was left maintaining altitude as the other two [[Starship/Legends|ships]] flanking it were ripped apart and pulled down through the atmosphere by [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]]. The ''Liberty'' attempted to return the enemy ships' fire but remained largely unsuccessful, eventually losing its [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]]. [[File:Battle_of_Quell.png|thumb|left|250px|The Separatist fleet deploys hundreds of rocket droids to board the crippled ''Liberty''.]] Soon, TF-1726 dispatched a force of several hundred [[Rocket pack/Legends|rocket pack]]–equipped [[B2-RP battle droid/Legends|B2-RP battle droids]] through the continuing [[Starfighter combat/Legends|starfighter dogfights]] to board the ''Liberty''. The [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super battle droids]] landed on the ''Liberty''{{'s}} battered hull and exploited the craters caused by the intense fire to enter the perforated [[Warship/Legends|warship]]. [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] were also sent to aid in storming the ''Liberty''. Catching sight of the incoming [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], Secura ordered her [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] officer, [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Marshal Commander]] [[Bly/Legends|CC-5052]], nicknamed "Bly," to repel the invaders. [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] Bly complied and led groups of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] from the [[327th Star Corps/Legends|327th Star Corps]] to fight the [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. At the same time, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] General [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]—having received word of Secura's plight—arrived out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] aboard his own [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], with [[Troop/Legends|troops]] under his command to reinforce those already fighting. While [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] stayed with the ''Resolute'' as its acting [[Commander/Legends|commander]], Skywalker departed with his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]; [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], nicknamed "Rex;" and [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] aboard several [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]] to board the heavily damaged ''Liberty'' and evacuate its crew before the ship could be destroyed. Skywalker also dispatched a [[Unidentified Consular-class cruiser (Quell)/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]] to assist in the evacuation. The ''Resolute'' moved into place and deployed its [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] reinforcements just as the ''Liberty'' began to list and enter further into Quell's atmosphere. The heavily armed gunships were soon met by the B2-RP battle droids, which launched from the ''Liberty'' to intercept the new arrivals and targeted their fire at the gunships. The Republic craft returned the droids' fire, using both their [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and [[Missile/Legends|rocket]] armaments to cut through the attacking Separatist forces, and numerous [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B interceptors]]—one [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]]—also fought the rocket droids and Vulture [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] that were attacking the ''Liberty''. A rocket droid landed on the gunship carrying Skywalker, Tano, and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Rex, tearing off the craft's [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] canopy and exposing the craft's [[Unidentified clone trooper pilot (Quell)/Legends|clone pilot]]. Ordering Tano and Rex to take care of their adversary, Skywalker himself chose to go ahead of the rest of his forces. He jumped out of the gunship and used a rocket droid to land on the ''Liberty'', focusing the droid's fire at its airborne comrades along the way. Upon penetrating the ''Liberty''{{'s}} hull and landing in one of the cruiser's corridors, Skywalker began to cut through the droids with his [[Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Meanwhile, the rocket droid aboard Tano's gunship attacked the craft's [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]] and forced him out of the cockpit. Although Rex and Tano were able to catch the pilot and pull him into the troop bay, the damage to the gunship that the droid had inflicted caused the craft to soar downward and slam straight into the ''Liberty''{{'s}} already damaged hull. Once the gunship had lodged itself in the ''Liberty'', Rex, Tano, and their clone [[Squad/Legends|squad]] disembarked their [[Fire/Legends|flaming]] craft without pause and began to fight their way through the cruiser's hallways and join the rest of the Republic forces on board the Star Destroyer. Meanwhile, TF-1726, calculating that his forces should have won four [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] prior, had grown increasingly impatient with the battle's prolonged span. He changed plans and ordered his [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]] to target all of their fire at the ''Liberty'', despite the hundreds of battle droids aboard that would be destroyed with the Republic cruiser. Rex and Tano eventually caught up with Skywalker and found Secura and Bly. The group continued to charge through the ''Liberty''{{'s}} walkways while cutting down all of the battle droids in their path. At Secura's inquiry, Skywalker reported his plan of gathering all evacuees aboard the [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]], which was in the process of docking at the ''Liberty''{{'s}} lower [[Hangar/Legends|hangar bay]]. Halting their fight against the droids, the Jedi and clones headed for the Star Destroyer's lower hold. Once the group had arrived there and had extended the gangway to the escape frigate, however, a raging inferno caused by the Separatists' increasing fire tore through the ship's corridors, consuming all clone troopers and battle droids in its path. Catching sight of the wall of fire, Skywalker sacrificed himself and used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|push]] Secura, Tano, Bly, Rex, and troopers [[Lucky/Legends|Lucky]], [[Flash/Legends|Flash]], and [[Cameron/Legends|Cameron]] into the gangway [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] before closing the [[Blast door/Legends|blast doors]] behind them. Skywalker then turned around to see the corridor's blast doors behind him seal shut but knew that the bulkheads would not be enough to contain the blast. [[File:LibertyRescue-JC.png|thumb|right|250px|The Jedi and clones head to flee the ''Liberty''.]] Offering whatever reinforcement he was able to provide with the Force, Skywalker found that he was unable to hold back the inferno. The blast doors buckled, and the force from the blast slammed him against the airlock, gravely wounding the Jedi and knocking him unconscious. Unwilling to leave her Master behind, Tano ordered the ''Consular''-class cruiser's clone pilots via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] to hold their position and opened the airlock's doors, which budged only enough for her to catch sight of the injured Skywalker. Using her [[Ahsoka Tano's lightsabers/Legends|lightsaber]] to cut a hole through the doors, Tano pulled Skywalker's inert form onto the small [[Transport/Legends|transport]] with assistance from Secura. Bly then closed the gangway's doors behind them and ran to the cockpit to activate the frigate's deflector shields. With explosions continuing to rock the ''Liberty'' and sending unavoidable fires raging through the Star Destroyer, the ''Consular''-class cruiser detached from the ventral hold and rocketed away, heading through the ongoing starfighter engagements for the ''Resolute''. While Skywalker was taken to the frigate's medical bay, Secura and Bly went to the ship's [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], from where Secura contacted Admiral Yularen on board the ''Resolute''. Yularen advised against docking in the middle of the battle, but Secura insisted on doing so, as Skywalker required medical attention beyond what their frigate could provide. At Yularen's behest, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who was with the Republic's starfighter forces cut a path through the opposing rocket droids and Vulture droid starfighters, allowing Skywalker's evacuation ship to safely approach the ''Resolute''. As the craft maneuvered around to dock with the ''Resolute'', a squadron of Vulture droid starfighters approached and released a barrage of fire at the frigate's cockpit. The attack slammed one of the pilots into the ship's controls, inadvertently activating the frigate's [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], which Bly was unable to shut down. Through the still-open connection to Yularen, Secura hurriedly told the admiral that their frigate was going into hyperspace. With the uncontrollable frigate gearing up for a hyperspace jump while still in the ''Resolute''{{'s}} hold and therefore presenting a danger to the Star Destroyer, Yularen ordered the ''Resolute'' to be maneuvered out of the way. The ''Resolute'' did just in time as the frigate jumped to hyperspace. Despite knowing that the Jedi's odds for survival were slim, as a jump through a [[Gravity well/Legends|gravity well]] like the one that the Jedi had executed was extremely dangerous, Yularen ordered his crew to plot every course along their last known trajectory, as the Republic forces needed to finish the battle and find the Jedi. The battle did not end well for the Republic and resulted in a Separatist victory. ==Aftermath== {{Quote|Plot every course along their last known trajectory! We need to finish this battle and find them!|Wullf Yularen, to his clone trooper crew, on the Jedi|}} [[File:ConsularMedbayJC.png|thumb|left|250px|Bly, Tano, and Secura look on as Skywalker is treated in the frigate's medbay.]] With their crippled ship soaring through hyperspace, Bly met with Tano and Secura in the ship's medbay, where Skywalker's condition was being monitored by the craft's resident [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B medical droid]]. Bly reported that the coordinates for the hyperspace jump had been input incorrectly into the frigate's [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] and stated that they were heading on a direct collision course with a [[Star/Legends|star]]. In order to reset the navicomputer's coordinates, the Jedi restarted the frigate's power, bringing the ship out of hyperspace into the [[Maridun system/Legends|Maridun system]] in time for Tano to pilot the craft out of its path into the star. Nevertheless, Tano was unable to prevent the frigate from crash-landing on the nearby [[Grass/Legends|grassy]] world of [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]]. Stranded on the little-known world, Tano and Secura went to find medical attention for the wounded and still unconscious Skywalker from the world's [[Lurmen/Legends|natives]]. Yularen eventually found the Jedi on Maridun in the wake of a [[Defense of Maridun/Legends|battle]] there against Separatist forces, arriving with a fleet of three ''Venator''-class Star Destroyers to rescue the Jedi.{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode014.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Defenders of Peace}} ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Unlike the beginning of ''Revenge of the Sith'', where they're in space looking down on the planet, we're in that middle ground, so there are all these contrails everywhere.|Series Development Artist Matt Gaser, who created a series of concept paintings for the battle|''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''}} [[File:QuellBattleConcept-Gaser.jpg|thumb|right|300px|One of the concepts that Gaser painted for the battle]] The Sky Battle of Quell was featured as the opening act of "[[Jedi Crash]]," the thirteenth episode in the [[2009]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series' [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]]. It highlighted the series' debut of Aayla Secura, an already well-known character from ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]],{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20090112.html|text=Jedi Aayla Secura Makes Her ''Clone Wars'' Debut}} as well as the introduction of the planet Quell. The T-series tactical droid and B2-RP battle droid models were additionally debuted in the battle. The battle itself set the groundwork for a story that tested the bond between Master-and-Padawan team Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano by putting the former in a near-[[Death/Legends|death]] situation.{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news011409.html|text=Anakin and Ahsoka's Bond Strengthens in "Jedi Crash"}} The battle received numerous mentions and entries in various sources, including the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]], [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles|''Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles'']],''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles]]'' ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'',''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1|''The Official Episode Guide: Season 1'']], and ''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', which finally gave it an official name. In [[2010]], the battle was featured in the "Starfighter" mini-game of the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'' video game]], and in [[2011]], it was one of the playable missions in the non-canonical ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]]. The main versions of the game mostly follow the storyline of "Jedi Crash,"''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'' but the [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] version of the game features several changes to the storyline. In this edition, the Confederacy uses [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|''Hyena''-class bombers]] against Aayla Secura's fleet, and Anakin Skywalker—instead of his Padawan, Ahsoka Tano—is the one who crashes on the ''Liberty'' via the LAAT/i gunship.''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'' [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] edition Because of a lack of evidence presented in "Jedi Crash," no result beyond the destruction of Secura's fleet could be drawn from the episode. However, the young readers' book ''[[The Clone Wars: Planets in Peril]]'' stated that the battle did not "end well" for the Republic forces, which is assumed to be a Separatist victory. Chronologically, the Sky Battle of Quell takes place some time after the [[Battle for the Galactic Republic information bunker|battle]] featured in ''[[The Clone Wars: Headgames]]'', the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|webcomic]] leading into the episode.''[[The Clone Wars: Headgames]]'' Originally planned as a [[Realspace/Legends|space]] battle like the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] that served as the opening of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], the engagement was moved to Quell's upper atmosphere during the episode's pre-production for a more dramatic effect. Series Development Artist [[Matt Gaser]] consequently painted a series of concepts for the battle.
